description: This file defines a JavaScript object called 'Datetimecombo' which manages rendering and handling of a datetime input widget. It includes functions for constructing the widget, rendering HTML, updating values based on user interaction, and generating associated JavaScript code for event handling. The script primarily serves as a utility for handling non-date portions of a datetime field in a CRM application's UI, specifically for call, meetings, and task views.

classes.name: Datetimecombo
classes.description: A JavaScript object managing rendering and logic for a custom datetime field widget, including HTML rendering, event handling, and value synchronization.

methods.name: Datetimecombo.prototype.jsscript
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code as a string for updating the datetime widget's value based on calendar events.

methods.name: Datetimecombo.prototype.html
methods.description: Renders the HTML form elements for the datetime widget, including select elements for hours, minutes, meridiem, and optional checkbox.

methods.name: Datetimecombo.prototype.update
methods.description: Handles events when user changes time or date inputs; updates the combined datetime value and manages checkbox state if present.
